game.title: Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom
game.blurb: Fantasy role-playing game from Level-5 and Bandai Namco, released 2018-03-23. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Twelve hidden story milestones, from the king in exile to the sea and the skies. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Building the Kingdom
chapters.summary: Recruiting subjects, building facilities in Evermore, upgrading Evermore Castle and raising your influence.

chapters.title: Side Quests and Errands
chapters.summary: Your first side quest up to 150, and errands up to 100.

chapters.title: Skirmishes
chapters.summary: Winning your first skirmish and overcoming 50 skirmish challenges.

chapters.title: Higgledies
chapters.summary: Higgledy stones, matching sets and cooking up 50 different higgledies.

chapters.title: Cooking, Crafting and Spells
chapters.summary: Cooking dishes, creating weapon and armour types, and upgrading spells.

chapters.title: Treasure, Trip Doors and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Treasure chests, trip doors, balls and golden balls, songbooks and guilders.

chapters.title: Battles, Tainted Monsters and Hidden Feats
chapters.summary: Defeating enemies, the hidden Tainted and dream achievements, and the rare hidden late-game feats. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 589360 was the only Ni no Kuni II match in the app list. RAWG's first search result matched the expected slug. 29 of 63 Steam achievements are hidden. The twelve hidden ones with API names ACHIEVEMENT_01000 to 01011 (from "One True King" to "King of the Skies") were placed in the story chapter by exact name, as they come first in the list; "One True King" is only 1.3% and may be the full-completion award rather than story. The other 17 hidden ones (Tainted monsters, three dream achievements and twelve with 1% to 7% unlock rates, such as "Solosseum Supremo" and "The Nightmare is Over") sit in the last chapter; they may be post-game or add-on content, but no add-on name is in the fetched data. Two achievements share the name "Higgledy Hotshot": the visible one (cook 50 higgledies) is in the Higgledies chapter and the hidden one (1.0%) is in the last chapter. "Tripple Threat" is spelled that way in the Steam schema. StrategyWiki has no page under "Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom", "Ni No Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom" or "Ni no Kuni II". ninokuni.fandom.com answers the API under "Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom" with about 42 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
